components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:36px;padding:8px 16px;border:0;border-radius:6px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);background:var(--primary,#18181b);color:var(--primary-foreground,#fff);box-shadow:0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);}.ds-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#18181b) 90%,transparent)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring,#71717a);}.ds-primary:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-outline{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:36px;padding:8px 16px;border:0;border-radius:6px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);background:var(--background,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#18181b);border:1px solid var(--input,#d4d4d8);box-shadow:0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);}.ds-outline:hover{background:#f4f4f5}.ds-outline:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring,#71717a);}.ds-outline:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}

components.name: Labeled Input
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-class">班级名称</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-class" placeholder="输入班级名称">
components.css: .ds-label{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink,#18181b)}.ds-field{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;width:100%;height:38px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid var(--input,#d4d4d8);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18181b);caret-color:var(--accent,#27272a);box-shadow:0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);transition:border-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#62626b);opacity:1}.ds-field:hover{border-color:var(--muted,#62626b)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring,#71717a);}.ds-field:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}.ds-field[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--error,#a22f2a)}

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Current section with inline Lucide-style icon and secondary text.
components.html: 班级管理班级与学生
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--ink,#18181b);background:#f4f4f5;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav small{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#62626b);font-weight:400}.ds-nav:hover{background:var(--paper,#fafafa)}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#27272a);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Secondary Status Badge
components.css: .ds-status{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 10px;background:var(--secondary,#f4f4f5);color:var(--secondary-foreground,#27272a);font-size:12px;line-height:16px;font-weight:600;transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)}.ds-status:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--secondary,#f4f4f5) 80%,transparent)}

components.name: Upload Panel
components.description: White working container with pale dashed upload target.
components.html:
上传试卷

选择 PDF、JPG 或 PNG 文件
components.css: .ds-panel{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e4e4e7);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#18181b)}.ds-panel h2{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:650;margin:0}.ds-drop{margin-top:20px;border:1px dashed var(--input,#d4d4d8);border-radius:8px;padding:28px;text-align:center;background:var(--paper,#fafafa);color:var(--muted,#62626b);transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-drop:hover,.ds-drop[data-dragging="true"]{background:#f4f4f5}

components.name: Grading Tabs
components.description: Personal and batch modes with white active trigger.
components.css: .ds-tabs{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:42px;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:8px;background:#f4f4f5;color:var(--muted,#62626b)}.ds-tab{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 16px;color:inherit;background:transparent;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)}.ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--background,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#18181b);box-shadow:0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--background,#fff),0 0 0 4px var(--ring,#71717a)}.ds-tab:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}

components.name: Current Question Boundary
components.description: Functional current-question selection and dashed grayscale figure bounds.
components.html: 题图
components.css: .ds-paper{position:relative;height:140px;background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--line,#e4e4e7)}.ds-bound{position:absolute;left:8%;top:24px;width:70%;height:48px;border:2px solid #2563eb;background:rgb(37 99 235 / 4%);padding:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-bound>span{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;padding:1px 5px;color:#fff;background:#2563eb;font-size:10px;line-height:16px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-bound:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#27272a);outline-offset:4px}.ds-figure{position:absolute;left:46%;top:88px;width:30%;height:30px;border:1px dashed #52525b;pointer-events:none}.ds-figure>span{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;font-size:10px;color:#fff;background:#52525b;padding:0 3px}

narrative.overview:
Operate is a white, full-width teaching workspace. Chinese labels, compact controls, neutral separators, and clear task states let teachers move between classes, reusable papers, grading, and learning analysis. The interface uses the established shadcn/ui new-york neutral primitives and the existing Chinese sans-serif stack.

The content carries the hierarchy: page title, task controls, then the working material. Original papers, question crops, and electronic questions remain visible together when space permits. Color identifies an actionable selection or an error; it is not a decorative backdrop.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white application surfaces with zinc text and borders.
Full-width work areas with a persistent desktop sidebar and mobile Sheet.
Compact shadcn/ui controls, restrained corners, and clear keyboard focus.
Original paper, crop, and electronic question form a coordinated review workspace.

rules.name: White Workspace
rules.body: The application shell and main work surface remain pure white; neutral fills mark local state and supporting surfaces.

rules.name: Selection Has Meaning
rules.body: Blue marks the current question on the original paper. Figure bounds remain dashed and grayscale.

rules.name: Flat Work Areas
rules.body: Use whitespace and neutral separators for structural depth. Keep shadows on stock controls and the mobile navigation Sheet.

dos: Do keep the workspace background pure white and use neutral borders to separate work areas.
Do use the existing shadcn/ui new-york neutral primitives and Lucide stroke icons.
Do preserve the original / crop / electronic question order as the grid collapses.
Do keep saved standard answers, their readiness status, and grading actions close to the question content.
Do show clear Chinese labels, recovery messages, empty states, and disabled or loading feedback.
donts: Don't introduce a decorative accent palette, gradients, illustrations, or a new display font.
Don't constrain the OA work area inside a centered narrow page container.
Don't use the blue question-selection treatment as a general brand accent.
Don't replace paper content or working tables with decorative metric cards.
Don't imply that teacher approval is required before a completed saved AI solution can be used for grading.
